schema_changelog: v2: Added operand_proof requirement to v1_required records.  Partial-coverage policy extended to also cover partial-reachability.  Both consumer_proof and operand_proof are mandatory; missing either disqualifies a unit from v1_required.

row_diagnostic.reason: Input-touch rows overcount combinatorial and non-product Mixer registrations; template necessity replaces row count as the closure metric.

forced_v1_templates.reason: Four-material coal/charcoal/carbon/coke plus niter/blaze-powder Mixer family automates gunpowder for the Beta industrial path.
forced_v1_templates.consumer_proof: minecraft:tnt and other vanilla gunpowder consumers
forced_v1_templates.operand_proof: All four operands (coal/dust, charcoal/dust, carbon/dust, coal_coke/dust, niter/dust) are reachable via ore chain (coal,niter), T5 electrolysis (carbon), and form_items gem bridge (charcoal, coal_coke).  Verified by tools/t21_operand_reachability.py --check exit 0 on 2026-08-10.

partial_coverage_policy: Split a replay-verified template by final row classification AND by operand reachability before denominator publication.  A unit with partially-covered rows or partially-reachable operands must be split; each sub-unit is independently classified.  No unit may mix already_covered and uncovered rows, nor reachable and unreachable operands.
other_maps_policy: The nine non-Mixer maps use exact source-row singleton units until their denominator size proves a dedicated extractor necessary.
